description: This Java interface defines the LogNode, a component in a logging chain that outputs log data to one or more targets. It includes a single method, println, which formats and displays or forwards log entries, potentially with throwable exceptions.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface representing a node in the logging chain responsible for outputting log data.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log entry with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable to the first LogNode in the chain.
